// Usage:
void drawGengar(int startX, int startY) {
  for (int y = 0; y < 64; y++) {
    for (int x = 0; x < 64; x++) {
      uint16_t color = gengar_sprite[y][x];
      if (color != 0x0000) {  // Skip transparent
        M5.Display.drawPixel(startX + x, startY + y, color);
      }
    }
  }
}
